title: Post-Operative Progress Note
brief: A post-operative nursing note for a patient recovering from a laparoscopic cholecystectomy, drafted from the bedside assessment and the MAR.

slip.document:
# Post-Operative Progress Note

Patient Rosa Navarro (DOB 04/12/1971), allergic to hydromorphone (hives), is alert, oriented x4 and resting comfortably after a laparoscopic cholecystectomy. Surgical dressings across four port sites are clean, dry and intact. Pain is 4/10 following hydromorphone 0.5 mg IV at 1330. Bed rails are up x2 and the call light is within reach.

errors.quote: Pain is 4/10 following hydromorphone 0.5 mg IV at 1330
errors.explanation: The note lists a hydromorphone allergy (hives) in the first sentence, yet records hydromorphone as given for pain.
errors.fix: Pain is 4/10 following acetaminophen 1,000 mg PO at 1330
